title: Episode 79 — Sacred Pool Hymn and the Volunteers’ Test

blocks.text: The page briefly broadens into devotional praise of the sacred pool founded by Guru Ramdas, reminding the reader that courage grows from immersion in the Guru's sanctifying presence. The hymn frames the coming ordeal as purification rather than spectacle.

It then returns to the volunteers themselves, and Majhail Singhs competed to offer their heads once grace steadied their hearts. Behind the visible drama, the Guru arranges a covered tent and hidden goats so that the congregation will confront the appearance of death before learning the truth.

This double movement—hymn and test—shows that martyrdom belongs to devotion before it belongs to legend. The page teaches the reader to understand the trial through sacred discipline, not through gore alone.
